87 products? Sab mein violation.  
46 blogs? Har ek mein “cure”, “helps”, “promotes” — sab FSSAI ke against.  
6 categories? “Cardiovascular Wellness” → “Heart Wellness Wellness”? Bhai, ye kya hai?  

**Abhi jo fix ho sakta hai:**  
- Product titles & descriptions: 87 each — sab API se rewrite karke apply kar deta hoon  
- Image alt text: 40 violations — fix kar deta hoon  
- Blogs & pages: 82 total — sab rewrite + publish  
- Categories: 6 duplicate — sahi naam se replace  

**Jo nahi ho sakta:**  
- OCR wale images (text inside images) — manual check chahiye, main nahi dekh sakta  
- Legal approval — main flag kar sakta hoon, lawyer nahi hoon  

**Top violations abhi bhi live hain:**  
- “Senna Leaves — Helps in getting rid of Constipation” → ❌ treatment  
- “Ashwagandha — Reduce Stress” → ❌ cure  
- “Amla — Supports Hair Growth” → ❌ constipation  
- Blogs: “Say Goodbye to Dull Skin”, “Unlock the Secrets of Ayurveda” — sab banned phrases  

**Action?**  
👉 “**sab fix karo**” bol de — main 4 ghante mein saara content compliant kar deta hoon.  
Nahi bola toh, aaj bhi ₹0 aayega, aur Google/FSSAI ka koi reply aane wala hai.
